# Background
- Want to relate to my research interests
    - How non-verbal gestures affect coordination within virtual environments
- Examples include eye gaze / contact, head nods, exaggerated body motions
- Experiment with some non-verbal gestures as input methods for project
- Using this project as an opportunity for VR development practice

---

- Will use Meta Quest 3 headset (provided by my supervisor Matthew Lakier)
- Prior research has found that using a head direction pointer is a good substitute for eye gaze tracking
    - Cheaper, more accessible, doesn't require complex eye tracking hardware
- Quest 3 also has built-in hand tracking using the headset's camera, want to experiment with this

- VR music workstation idea from beginning of term
- More emphasis on non-verbal gestures as inputs

# Plan
- Build project in Unity and C#, as its XR Interaction Toolkits and plugins simplify VR integration and development. 
- Will use Quest 3 headset (provided by supervisor Dr. Lakier)
- Modalities implemented:
    - Vision (virtual reality is vision-focused!)
    - Audio (audio feedback from notes)
    - Interaction (using non-verbal gestures to interact with workstation)
